Package Overview

Package-level documentation: what the package builds, who it’s for, and how the verify workflow fits together.

hvtiRdatabuild hvtiRdatabuild-package
hvtiRdatabuild: Build and Verify Analytic Datasets for the HVTI CORR Group

Verify: R Build vs. SAS Oracle

Freeze a SAS-built dataset as a checksummed parquet oracle, then compare an R-built dataset against it. Use snapshot_oracle() once per legacy SAS dataset to create the frozen reference; use compare_built() for every R rebuild you want to verify against it.

snapshot_oracle()
Freeze a SAS-built dataset as a checksummed parquet oracle
compare_built()
Compare an R-built dataset against a SAS oracle
print(<built_comparison>)
Print a dataset comparison
str(<built_comparison>)
Structure of a dataset comparison, without identifiers

Pull: Warehouse to R

Read a study’s configuration, open a credentialed warehouse connection, and pull the modules the study declares. The pull is read-only.

read_study_config()
Read and validate a study configuration
dw_connect()
Open a connection to the data warehouse
dw_modules()
List the available warehouse modules
dw_pull()
Pull the enabled warehouse modules for a study
print(<pull_result>)
Print a pull result
